title: Pasted mate identity for the constructed inverse-image open comparison
statement: Assume derived module categories on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and g′:X′→X form a cartesian square, K in D(O_X), K′ in D(O_X′), φ:Lg′K→K′, and W an arbitrary open of X. Let eW=relativeMVInverseOpenIso(g′,f′,W,K′), the specified construction of [lem-pc-relative-mv-inverse-open-iso], and E(f,W,K)=relativeMVExactOpenIso(f,W,K) [lem-pc-relative-mv-exact-open-comparison]. Then mvBaseChangeOpenMap(f,f′,g,g′,hpull.w,K,K′,φ,W)≫eW.hom equals Lg of E(f,W,K).hom followed by relativeMVLocalArrow(f,f′,g,g′,hpull,K,K′,φ,W).hom [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components, def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. This is only the mate-compatibility clause for a fixed comparison: it asserts neither existence of comparisons nor their unit or restriction equations, and it does not quantify over arbitrary isomorphisms.

proof.text: Expand mvBaseChangeOpenMap and the specified inverse-open comparison. Apply the proved coefficient transport on X′ inside Rf′.

Use coefficient naturality of the global base-change map to move the exact-to-pinned W comparison to the source. Naturality of relativeMVImageComp moves the coefficient arrow through the target composition comparison.

Apply horizontal pasting to W.ι,f,p,f′,g,g′,v and LW K, then postcompose with R(p≫f′) of the coefficient arrow. Functoriality combines the two source factors into Lg of relativeMVExactOpenIso; the target composite is the defining relativeMVLocalArrow.

theorem relativeMVInverseOpenIso_mate
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (W : X.Opens) :
    mvBaseChangeOpenMap f f' g g' hpull.w K K' φ W ≫
        (relativeMVInverseOpenIso g' f' W K').hom =
      ((derivedPullback g).mapIso (relativeMVExactOpenIso f W K)).hom ≫
        (relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ W).hom
